about_the_game:
Story Background
On a seemingly lighthearted April Fool’s Day, the protagonist is unexpectedly drawn into terrifying supernatural events. From eerie visions to unsettling sounds, every step is filled with unknown terror. As the investigation deepens, you’ll discover these events are tied to an unsolved tragedy from years ago. The truth awaits, and your choices shape the protagonist’s fate, determining life or death. In this suspenseful adventure, explore haunting scenes, unravel complex mysteries, and confront lurking horrors—can you stay calm and survive?

Gameplay
In this game, you play as the protagonist, exploring a mysterious and dangerous world in first-person perspective. Interact with objects, gather clues, solve puzzles, and make impactful choices at critical moments. The game is highly interactive, with detailed scenes hiding clues and secrets. Your choices influence the story and character’s fate, leading to different endings. Face threats bravely or avoid danger cautiously—every step tests your wit and courage.

Game Features

  • Multiple Endings: Various story paths shaped by player choices, unlocking unique endings with high replay value.

  • Immersive Horror Experience: Crafted scare elements and gripping storytelling, with realistic sound and visuals, immerse players in a terrifying supernatural world.

  • Deep Narrative and Interaction: Rich story and interactive scenes let players uncover the truth through exploration and puzzles, delivering an immersive experience.

  • Active Community and Updates: We foster a friendly player community, with the team listening to feedback and releasing regular updates for an evolving experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11
  • Processor: Core i5 processor or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 760 or AMD Radeon™ R7 260x with 2GB Video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible（must support DirectX 9.0c or higher）
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11
  • Processor: Core i5 processor or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX1060 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible（must support DirectX 9.0c or higher）
